g.text: Analogue voice only (AMPS). FDMA, 2.4 kbps, poor security, large handsets
Digital voice (GSM, CDMA). TDMA, SMS, encryption, up to 64 kbps
Packet data, early mobile internet and MMS, up to 384 kbps
UMTS / WCDMA, video calls, mobile web, up to 2 Mbps (HSPA 14 Mbps)
All-IP network, OFDMA and MIMO, HD video and apps, up to 1 Gbps
